paper_title: Tur[k]ingBench A Challenge Benchmark for Web Agents
caption: Distribution of errors in a single run of GPT4 across all tasks
model_annotation: This figure illustrates the distribution of error types observed in a single run of GPT-4 across all tasks. The figure is a pie chart, with each slice representing the proportion of a specific error type. The slices are arranged clockwise, beginning with “Bad Response” at the top-left, labeled with a percentage value of 1.5%. Subsequent slices are labeled “Unknown” (8.3%), “Syntax Error” (2.3%), “Partial” (11.3%), “Correct” (31.6%), “Incorrect” (43.6%), and an unlabeled slice. The slices are colored as follows: “Bad Response” is teal, “Unknown” is orange, “Syntax Error” is yellow, “Partial” is red, “Correct” is red, and “Incorrect” is blue. Each label is positioned adjacent to its corresponding slice with an underline and a percentage value. A small white circle is present in the center of the pie chart, visually separating the segments.
